EDITOR’S PICKS FROM THE ARCHIVE
The Mast House · Bridgehampton
“The clearest example we’ve filed of a house designed for one specific stretch of horizon.” — CW
The Schindler Annex · Silver Lake
“Eight months on market, three architects circling, and a closing that finally honoured the drawings.” — QM
Villa Skogsbacken · Saltsjöbaden
“A Tham & Videgård house that the listing photos refuse to do justice. Read the dossier instead.” — MH
19 Rue de Sévigné · Le Marais
“A Dirand interior aged exactly long enough to feel inevitable. Sold in nine days.” — IC
The Bourse Warehouse · Fishtown
“Erdy McHenry’s most patient conversion — still listed, still mispriced, still extraordinary.” — QM
